prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic direct-flash paparazzi portrait of a generic adult woman looking back over her left shoulder toward camera. She has long dark-brown straight-to-slightly-wavy hair parted in the middle, light natural complexion with freckles, defined lashes, glossy brown-red lipstick and realistic pores. She wears an opaque black fashion dress with a tasteful open-back design and one off-shoulder strap, plus a gold bangle, layered gold bracelets and rings. Set her indoors against a textured exposed red-and-brown brick wall with razor-sharp mortar detail and a distinct hard shadow cast directly behind her. Use hard neutral on-camera flash, high contrast, bright cheekbone highlights, 35–50mm lens, f/8–f/11, ISO 100, 1/200s, deep depth of field and sharp textures. Preserve edgy adult fashion intent without reproducing Jenna Ortega or any public-figure likeness.
